source.title: Cherry for Your Thoughts?
source.description:
You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.

The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.

I'll tell ya the whole story if you buy me some grog.
source.objective: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
source.completion: Ah, that's the stuff. Now, where was I?
